development_inputs.prompts: Original frozen questions unchanged; development screen only. No official test tasks selected by failure outcome.
development_inputs.scoring: Existing deterministic QA semantic/format/safety gates; code evaluated only inside original CPU sandbox. Source task per-case output limits overridden uniformly to4096 for both arms; do not conflate this diagnostic with the original QA12 score.

early_stop: Hard900s for entire paired trial; retain partial raw data and do not report a full score.
Any source/weight/template hash mismatch or unverifiable thinking-mode switch.
not_justified: Re-scoring reasoning text as final code would change answer-selection semantics and is not an admissible correction.
Changing only --no-reasoning-preserve is not a remedy established by these single-turn tasks; no previous assistant trace exists.
Do not simultaneously change thinking, sampler, engine, context and output cap and call it an isolated optimization.
Do not replay all164 HumanEval tasks for tuning; independent validation must disclose prior test exposure.
followup.practical_minimum: At least20% lower paired task latency or removal of observed empty-final failures, with all previously successful development tasks still passing; one screen is not independent winner qualification.
followup.primary_metric: Successful development tasks per total paired-arm inference second; zero quality/safety regression required. No general benchmark qualification from n4.

admission_prerequisites: Pin original native recipe and template to the recorded binary/model hashes.
Validate the non-thinking native template path and captured prompt suffix without model generation.
Register a closed dev-dataset adapter/profile; an existing profile must not be mutated.
Enforce trusted whole-trial900s deadline including both arms, preflight/load/warmup/collection.
Obtain the separate GPU approval required by issue12.
proposals.hypothesis: Suppressing the open thinking prefix may make final output available within the4096-token cap and reduce latency; quality benefit unverified.

A.reasoning_budget: unrestricted, actual baseline must be captured

admission_prerequisites: Local source exposes --reasoning-budget; verify the actual tokenizer/parser and generated closing-marker path before admitting the trial.
Same independent approval and900s whole-trial gate as P0.
proposals.hypothesis: A true reasoning-token cap may leave capacity for final code inside the unchanged4096 total output budget. No claim that this is already supported correctly by the actual parser/sampler path.

source_review.interpretation: Pinned local source review supports flag meanings; runtime behavior is established separately by the recorded native responses. The snapshot reports no upstream commit.

operator_stop.scope: A partial source-tensor comparison does not prove identity for every tensor, nor exact Q6 conversion lineage. Preserve the original53/164 result without declaring a trained-model verdict.

archived_diagnostics.statistics_method: Median and linearly interpolated P90 at position(n-1)*0.9; request wall sums exclude startup/warmup/scoring. Reasoning characters are not token counts.

summary.decision: Observed 104 empty final outputs are fully explained at the recorded-interface level by the4096-token generation cap being reached before reasoning closure. No lost post-reasoning final content is observed. The reason for prolonged reasoning, benefits of disabling thinking or changing the thinking budget, and cross-model causal effects remain unverified. Original53/164 score is preserved; no hidden-reasoning code is promoted to a final answer.

historical_comparisons.comparability: Historical whole-profile comparison: weights, quantization, endpoint, thinking mode, output cap and sampling differ; MTP also differs for OmniCoder2. No causal model-speed or tuning claim.
historical_comparisons.interface: /completion; historical non-thinking task profile, not the R448 chat protocol

external_claim.maintainer_response: Acknowledged tensor comparison and said the export/checkpoint path would be investigated; acknowledgment is not a corrected-weight release.
external_claim.status: EXTERNALLY REPORTED; independent payload census in progress

weight_provenance.next_decision: Hold all OxCoder GPU optimization follow-ups pending the independent tensor census and resolution of source-to-Q6 lineage. Existing53/164 remains an observed score of the pinned tested artifact, not evidence of advertised fine-tuning superiority or inferiority.

source_lineage.implication: A Q6 artifact identity is proven, its exact upstream trained-checkpoint provenance is not. Do not claim the advertised fine-tuning quality from the R448 score.

upstream_safetensors.limitation: HF commit/file metadata was independently retrieved; full safetensors file SHA was not independently streamed yet.

artifact_availability.note: Removed variants, including the integrated MTP-derived artifact, remain scientifically documented but require re-fetch or reconstruction before replay. Original main Q6_K and its alias remain.

provenance_findings.V1_quantizer: Publisher specifies llama.cpp b8292 and importance-matrix quantization. The GGUF itself records248 imatrix entries and802 calibration chunks.
provenance_findings.V2_quantizer: Publisher labels static quants and links separately to imatrix variants. The retained file has250 Q6_K and177 F32 tensors. Its conversion/build/calibration inputs are not independently reconstructed. Missing imatrix metadata alone is not proof no imatrix was used.
provenance_findings.V2_upstream_lineage: The retained V2 GGUF SHA256 matches the pinned quantizer LFS object. Its declared source is Tesslate/OmniCoder-2-9B, but an exact upstream conversion revision or verified unquantized source identity is unavailable. The GGUF declares a quantization timestamp of2026-03-25T10:47:42+01:00; this is metadata, not an independently verified release chronology.

cached_source_object_observation.limit: Previously cached public HF metadata reports one identical complete safetensors object for V1 upstream and the disputed OxCoder source. Neither full source file was downloaded or independently hashed here. This does not establish V2 lineage, a corrected checkpoint, training history or publisher intent. OxCoder inspection remains stopped by user request.

provenance_findings.reported_faulty_release_relationship: NOT VERIFIED. No exact V2 upstream revision or corrected-versus-original source payload binding is established. Neither two different GGUF hashes nor their quantized numerical differences establish the claimed fine-tune or resolve a reported faulty initial release. The historical benchmark still measures the exact retained artifact.

result.quantization_noise_conclusion: No matched unquantized source pair or independently calibrated quantizer error controls are available. Differences of decoded quantized values alone do not establish a new fine-tune or a difference beyond source quantization/conversion effects. Reported per-tensor exact differences/RMSE are measurements, not a training-delta significance test.

source_evidence.role: Previously cached OxCoder metadata; no resumed investigation

result.training_history_conclusion: Not proven from file hashes, names or quantized differences. Upstream revision/derivation evidence must be considered separately.

conclusions.Jarvis_specialist: Phase2 GUI grounding is a conditional specialist prospect; HDL only for a genuine hardware-design need. Neither is an allroundreplacement.
conclusions.best_coding_potential: Nexus first for direct coding-parent merge relevance andreadyQ6; Slopus second for documented efficiency tradeoff; Claude-distill third with weak recipe provenance. Research priority only, no quality ranking.
conclusions.exclude_now: EmptyCISPOcheckpoint/no-weight repositories and incorrectformatroutes are technical exclusions only. Missinglicense/basecomposition routes deferred; no quality rejection from an absent benchmark.
conclusions.genuine_weight_changes: Changed sameBF16 source values in3candidates and nonzero effectiveLoRA deltas in3adapters are locally observed; objectives, teacher provenance and quality gains are not thereby proven.
conclusions.watch: Tessera compressed reasoning, Polaris/Geryon merges and OpenClaw-labelled adapters need more evidence; keep disclosed negative results.
conclusions.worth_switching: Not established. No new candidate has local comparable quality/latency/energy/VRAM data. Maintain current qualified baseline and larger-model references.

coverage_notes.benchmark_family_text_scan: HumanEval/MBPP/BFCL/SWE/Terminal/LiveCodeBench plusRL/SFT/merge terms inspected across captured cards; baseline-parent copied tables are not reattributed to children.
coverage_notes.release_lineage: Current HF base revisions are indexed; exact original training/merge revisions remain NOT RECORDED where absent.
coverage_notes.training_claims: Training recipes and current commits are evidence of what is published, not complete verification of historical training execution.

candidate_research.inventory_scope: Bounded public HuggingFace name search, baseline relation filters, author andlinked-repository discovery; no claim to enumerate untagged/private/deleted models worldwide. Quantizations and reuploads are not new trained checkpoints.

proposed_profiles.budget_covers: startup, all generation parts, retries, verification phases and cleanup; no reset between parts
proposed_profiles.comparison_limit: Historical references use differing sampling, templates, MTP and output budgets. No controlled model-superiority or optimization delta until exact comparable fresh/stored profiles are available.
